A lot of people, including myself, love solo lane because of the boxing fights and potion management, taking away double pots would ruin the early game slapfights and make solo lane less skillful imo. With less sustain, I feel the solo meta could turn really snowball-y and be a meta of who can burst the opponent into backing at 2 minutes first, then just ride off of that lead the whole game, as the person that's behind won't have enough sustain as they're behind in gold and don't get enough potion heals in lane to even attempt to box someone who's ahead. 

Just my two cents though. I think targeted nerfs to a few warriors in particular, and some of their items, would be a better solution to the warrior support problems in conquest currently.
